headlines.title: 上半年信贷投向出炉 金融资源向新质生产力集聚
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行昨天（28日）公布上半年信贷投向。上半年，人民币贷款增加了10.72万亿元。梳理贷款投向，上半年信贷资金流向呈现明显结构性变化。传统房地产贷款增速放缓，而聚焦科技创新等领域的贷款增速亮眼，金融资源正向科创、算力新基建等新质生产力领域加速集聚。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: First-half credit flows released; financial resources concentrated on new productive forces
headlines.summary_en: PBOC yesterday (28th) released H1 credit direction. H1 yuan loans increased by 10.72 trillion yuan. Credit flow showed clear structural shifts: traditional real estate loan growth slowed, while loans focusing on tech innovation and other sectors posted strong growth, with financial resources accelerating toward new quality productive forces such as tech innovation and computing power new infrastructure. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 合肥上半年GDP为7073亿元，同比增长6.8%
headlines.summary: 合肥市统计局发布2026年上半年合肥经济运行情况。根据地区生产总值统一核算结果，上半年，全市地区生产总值（GDP）7073亿元，按不变价格计算，同比增长6.8%，高于全国水平（4.7%），持平于合肥市今年一季度GDP增速。分产业看，第一产业增加值118.8亿元，增长2.2%；第二产业增加值2552.4亿元，增长10.3%；第三产业增加值4401.8亿元，增长5.0%。上半年，全市规模以上工业增加值同比增长25.6%，创近年来新高；社会消费品零售总额2800.58亿元，同比增长0.6%。

headlines.title_en: Hefei GDP reached 707.3 billion yuan in H1, up 6.8% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Statistics Bureau of Hefei released the city's economic performance for the first half of 2026. According to unified GDP accounting, H1 total GDP was 707.3 billion yuan, up 6.8% YoY at constant prices, outpacing the national 4.7% and flat from Hefei's Q1 GDP growth. By industry, primary sector value added was 11.88 billion yuan (+2.2%), secondary sector 255.24 billion yuan (+10.3%), and tertiary sector 440.18 billion yuan (+5.0%). H1 industrial value added above designated size surged 25.6% YoY, a recent high; total retail sales of consumer goods were 280.058 billion yuan, up 0.6% YoY.

headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.

headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际数据显示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产的最大非本地买家群体，受惠于香港写字楼市场低迷期间不良资产价格大幅回调的吸引。鉴于写字楼资产价格仍处低位，未来数月新加坡资金需求预计将保持稳定。

headlines.title: 央行上海总部：继续深化自由贸易账户功能升级试点
headlines.summary: 【央行上海总部：继续深化自由贸易账户功能升级试点】人民银行上海总部召开2026年第三季度新闻发布会，人民银行上海总部宏观审慎管理部副主任施建东表示，上半年，上海自由贸易账户功能升级试点参与主体稳步扩容。该项工作自2025年12月正式启动以来，目前已有11家银行、42家优质企业参与试点，服务对象广泛涵盖了央国企、外资、民营等多类经济主体，服务汽车制造、现代农业、半导体等多个行业领域，试点项下跨境资金收付规模折合人民币已超过1330亿元。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Shanghai HQ: Continue deepening free trade account function upgrade pilot
headlines.summary_en: [PBOC Shanghai HQ: Continue to deepen free trade account function upgrade pilot] PBOC Shanghai HQ held 2026 Q3 press conference. Deputy Director of Macroprudential Management Department Shi Jiandong said H1 Shanghai FT account function upgrade pilot participants steadily expanded. Since launch in Dec 2025, 11 banks and 42 high-quality enterprises have participated, covering state-owned, foreign, and private entities, serving auto manufacturing, modern agriculture, semiconductors, etc. Cross-border fund flows under the pilot exceeded 133 billion yuan in RMB terms.

headlines.title: 经济学家：市场料将更多关注美联储信号，较少关注利率决定
headlines.summary: 市场普遍预计美联储将维持联邦基金利率不变，但Generali Investments高级经济学家Paolo Zanghieri在一份报告中表示，更重要的事情将是美联储传递的信息。预计，随着持续的通胀、油价上涨以及美联储内部的分歧为今年晚些时候进一步紧缩政策敞开大门，决策者将维持甚至强化偏紧缩的基调。这符合Generali更广泛的预期，即尽管整体通胀有所缓解，但粘性通胀将使央行保持谨慎。市场将较少关注利率决定本身，而更多地关注有关9月会议以及通胀风险与经济增长之间平衡的任何信号。

headlines.title_en: Economists: Market expected to focus more on Fed signals, less on rate decision
headlines.summary_en: Markets widely expect Fed to keep rates unchanged, but Generali Investments senior economist Paolo Zanghieri said in a note the more important aspect will be the Fed's messaging. Policymakers are expected to maintain or even reinforce a hawkish bias, as persistent inflation, rising oil prices, and internal Fed divisions open the door to further tightening later this year. This aligns with Generali's broader expectation that sticky inflation will keep central banks cautious despite easing headline inflation. Markets will focus less on the rate decision itself and more on any signals regarding the September meeting and the balance between inflation risk and growth.
